item: row 446: the collector flush's hold of the writer gate, by phase, in the pass summary
summary: Each committed collector flush records where it held the single-writer gate: insert, index writes, links and commit inside the gate, and exists, precompute and after-commit outside it. The pass summary line in collect_perf.jsonl carries them as collector_flush, with flushes, articles, the hold's total, mean and longest. A flush redone article by article is not counted. Measurement only: no write changes. The November field analysis measured 74 s per flush and could not say which statements made it up.
